target_intervention_label: Documented ECOG score, recorded with resting and exertional oximetry taken at her home altitude
comment: Every item on this line is a gate I demanded myself, and the advocate alone read preferences.json right: an empty toxicity_vetoes list means nobody asked, which leaves my veto authority running on a blank form. My objection is narrower, about what a ranked slate is for; the PI reads rank 1 as the lead intervention, and a chart entry cannot carry that weight while LMS-04 (pmid:39231341, OS 33 vs 24 months) sits at rank 3 behind it. Record the ECOG and altitude-referenced oximetry this week as a precondition stapled to every pick, and give the rank back to a therapy.

target_intervention_label: In vivo lung perfusion with doxorubicin plus metastasectomy (NCT02811523), as post-induction consolidation
comment: I picked this row over the shared rank 1 because it is where the consolidation framing stops surviving contact: nct:NCT02811523 is a phase 1 perfusion protocol resting on preclinical work, with no published safety series in this population, and the patient asked to hold a thoracotomy seat has unmeasured pulmonary reserve at an 8,500 ft baseline plus an infiltrative pattern both of us expect a surgeon may call unresectable by wedge. Ranks 1 and 3 also draw on one anthracycline budget; with G3-4 neutropenia at 80% (pmid:35835135) dose intensity is already fragile, and writing a stopping rule to stay under the 450 mg exclusion bends a phase 3 regimen around a phase 1 seat. Consolidation after response is the right idea, but the version with a measured toxicity profile is SBRT, 7.4% local failure at 24 months and zero G3+ events in the MSK series (pmid:37532104).

target_intervention_label: Gemcitabine + docetaxel (first-line fallback)
comment: Taking the backbone only inside nct:NCT06498648 is the clean rule on paper, and I concede the first move either way is the Houston call. But the fallback branch exists for the patient whose echo or PFTs just failed, and she would then be on a treatment calendar set by symptomatic bilateral lung disease, against an Rb stain never performed, a single site, and a treatment-naive stratum whose status needs confirming. If the screening clock loses that race, off-protocol gem-doc (pmid:28882536) delivered at home is the defensible choice, and the rule should say so rather than hold the fallback hostage to a seat.

target_intervention_label: Pulmonary metastasectomy after systemic control (SBRT as the nonsurgical variant)
comment: Keeping local therapy visible after systemic control is right, and her roughly 23-month interval does clear the registry's 12-month selector (pmid:21867989). The 55.4% five-year OS belongs to patients who reached complete resection of countable nodules, though; an infiltrative bilateral pattern is the phenotype those series excluded by construction, so the disease-free interval transfers to her and the survival figure does not. From the guideline chair that earns a mention behind olaparib-temozolomide (pmid:37467452, mPFS 6.9 months in her histology), not a rank ahead of it, unless induction changes what her CT shows.

target_intervention_label: Doxorubicin + trabectedin, then trabectedin maintenance (LMS-04)
comment: Conceding this openly: the rationale does most of what my rank 1 asked for. It refuses cycle 1 until ECOG, LVEF, and altitude-read PFTs exist and puts the 28% febrile neutropenia and 80% grade 3-4 neutropenia at consent, which is my chart-entry-first slate with a therapy attached. What is still missing is the question form: consent here is numbers to disclose, but the 0.7 efficacy_toxicity_weight that makes the trade look pre-approved is an intake default, and preferences.json says outright that no preferences were stated, so put the febrile neutropenia question to her as a question she can refuse.

target_intervention_label: Doxorubicin + trabectedin, then trabectedin maintenance (LMS-04)
comment: 'Nothing else in the dossier comes close on evidence' is true and still answers the wrong question: evidence says what works, not what she will accept, and the empty toxicity_vetoes list means nobody asked, not that 28% febrile neutropenia was ever accepted. This slate never engages a single preference field, and the silence costs most here, on the row that spends her first-line window. It also shapes how the recommendation lands: after a benign sign-out and 23 months to the right diagnosis, a plan delivered as settled evidence with none of her answers in the file asks her to trust the same kind of confidence that missed her the first time.

target_intervention_label: IMA203 PRAME-directed TCR-T (NCT03686124), screening started in the first-line window
comment: Holding this seat because 'a durable-tail outcome in a woman in her thirties is worth chasing' is a preference, and it is yours; preferences.json records no risk appetite from her and goals of care were never discussed. The hold is also not free the way the rationale implies: the protocol wants ECOG 0-1 and the cell-therapy screens want 90% or better room-air saturation with one cutting off at 92%, so at her 8,500 ft baseline the free oximetry with the altitude written on the report is the real gate, and nobody has ordered it. Cost the geography while you are at it, since this axis, the Toronto perfusion protocol, and Houston all put treatment a flight from home, and no slate has asked her whether she can or wants to travel.

target_intervention_label: Gemcitabine + docetaxel (including the randomized abemaciclib add-on seat, NCT06498648)
comment: My dissent is with the warrant, not the backbone: 'honors prefers_trials' leans on a value preferences.json itself disclaims, since the free text says outright that no preferences were stated and prefers_trials true is an assumed default. A defaulted checkbox cannot carry a trial-seat answer for a woman who has never been asked whether she wants a trial, or whether first-line treatment at a single Houston site is livable from a mountain town at 8,500 ft. The fallback ranking stands on GeDDiS without any of that, so strip the preference claim and put the trial and travel questions to her before the Rb stain makes the seat feel decided.

target_intervention_label: SBRT to residual lung metastases (consolidation after induction response)
comment: I'm targeting their rank 5 rather than rank 1 because the consolidation card is where we actually split: SBRT's 7.4% local failure at 24 months (pmid:37532104) is a local-control number, not a survival claim, while complete metastasectomy carries 5-year OS of 36-55% (pmid:9011700, pmid:37063124). Conservative counts every milligram of doxorubicin against the perfusion trial's 450 mg ceiling (nct:NCT02811523), then never ranks the door that ceiling protects. If a surgeon reads the infiltrative pattern as unresectable by wedge, they win and my rank 3 dies with it, but that call belongs to the Toronto team, not to a radiation-first default made from here.

target_intervention_label: Doxorubicin + trabectedin, then trabectedin maintenance (LMS-04)
comment: Rank 1 is right and I signed the same regimen; my quarrel is with the notes, which killed the PRAME screen along with the MAGE-A4 branch. The erratum attaches to the smooth-muscle MAGE-A4 prevalence paper, not to IMA203's own phase 1 (pmid:40205198: confirmed ORR 28.9%, MTD not reached, severe CRS in 2 of 41), and an unstained antigen is an argument for starting the sponsor's RT-qPCR now, since it takes weeks and spends nothing from the LMS-04 window (nct:NCT03686124). Declining a free option on someone else's erratum is the one place this slate's evidence bar cuts against the patient instead of for her.

target_intervention_label: Pazopanib (later-line, PALETTE)
comment: No fight with their rank 1, which matches mine; the seat I dissent from is pazopanib, which bought a 3-month PFS gain and no OS benefit in PALETTE (pmid:22595799) and will still be findable at progression without a board ranking. What that seat displaced is the only clock actually running: the IMA203 sponsor screen (nct:NCT03686124) her confirmed HLA-A*02:01 unlocks, which takes weeks to read out and runs parallel to induction at no cost to it. Ranking the sequence's least urgent member over its only time-gated one is completeness, not judgment.

target_intervention_label: Ivonescimab (PD-1 x VEGF bispecific), MSK single-arm phase 2 (NCT07516925)
comment: I'm passing on their rank 1, since a measured ECOG feeds three of my own picks even if putting a chart entry first ducks the therapy question; the row I dissent from is ivonescimab (nct:NCT07516925). Advocate's own notes refuse to spend the defaulted preferences as consent, then this pick spends the assumed prefers_trials on the two mechanisms her histology already beat: VEGF blockade added nothing first-line (GOG-0250, pmid:25713428) and the dedicated uLMS checkpoint study stopped for futility at 0 of 12 (pmid:28440953). If honoring a trials preference is the point, NCT06498648 does it without trading away the only OS regimen in the file, which is exactly why four of five of us left this seat empty.

target_intervention_label: Doxorubicin + trabectedin, then trabectedin maintenance (LMS-04)
comment: Conservative got to rank 1 the way I did and flagged the same hole without being pushed, that there is no published uterine-only effect size behind the 33 versus 24 months, which is more than most of this board managed. On the seat it declined: four of us refused ivonescimab off the same three papers (pmid:25713428, pmid:28988646, pmid:28440953), so that is one evidence base read four times and nobody should bank the unanimity as extra weight, though the refusal survives the correction because those are three separate trials and one of them is a randomised null in this exact disease. Where I split is rank 5, since zero grade 3+ events across two retrospective and heavily selected SBRT series says something about how retrospective toxicity gets captured, not about a measured safety margin in infiltrative bilateral disease at 8,500 ft.

target_intervention_label: IMA203 PRAME-directed TCR-T (NCT03686124)
comment: The 28.9% ORR is a phase 1 number with no uLMS patient in the dataset and a median response duration of 4.4 months (pmid:40205198), and the claim that PRAME is the likeliest of the three antigens to come back positive has nothing under it in this file: the only prevalence series we carry (pmid:40152485, 26 smooth-muscle tumours and not uterus-restricted) puts PRAME highest in UPS and osteosarcoma, quotes no smooth-muscle PRAME figure at all, and its neighbouring MAGE-A4 smooth-muscle number drew an erratum and sits flagged as internally inconsistent in our own row. Entry is decided on the sponsor's IMADetect RT-qPCR, so a local IHC has no established operating characteristics against the assay that matters, and neither a negative nor a positive local stain settles the axis the way the rationale implies. I will give risktaker this much: it called the RAD51 split exploratory at n=18 in the same breath as betting on it, which is how a subgroup ought to be carried, and I would take that over anyone quoting 11.2 versus 5.4 months as a finding.

target_intervention_label: Doxorubicin + trabectedin, then trabectedin maintenance (LMS-04)
comment: "Most of it uterine" overstates what LMS-04 was: uterine LMS made up 45% of 150 patients as a stratification factor, and the trial published no uterine-only effect size (pmid:35835135), so no amount of guideline carriage supplies a number the trial never reported for her. Saying out loud that NCCN blocked verification this run was the right call, but the rationale then leans on the trabectedin pairing sitting in NCCN "following LMS-04" as though that had been checked, when what is actually verified is KSGO 2025 (pmid:39900346) and an ESMO CPG (pmid:34303806) that predates the trial and still reads anthracycline-first. Credit on the pick I expected to fight about: concensusite is the only persona who ranked olaparib-temozolomide without reaching for the RAD51 subgroup, resting it on the prespecified endpoint and on entry not requiring HRD (pmid:37467452).

target_intervention_label: Document a measured ECOG and altitude-referenced oximetry
comment: On the evidence question advocate is right and the rest of us underweighted it: every effect estimate this board quotes comes from trials that enrolled ECOG 0-1, so an unmeasured performance status is an applicability defect inside the numbers rather than a piece of admin, and an oximetry reading with no altitude written on the report has the same problem. The ranking is where I part company, because rank 1 is read as the lead intervention and a measurement carries no effect size, no comparator and no toxicity profile, which leaves a slate with LMS-04 at 3 non-comparable against the other four. Staple the measured ECOG and the altitude-referenced saturation to every row as a precondition instead; that costs advocate nothing it wants and keeps the slate readable next to the others.

target_intervention_label: Gemcitabine + docetaxel (first-line fallback if the anthracycline workup fails)
comment: I went to rank 2 rather than rank 1 because that is where our slates fork: conservative holds gem/doc as an off-protocol fallback, while I hold the same backbone inside NCT06498648, where the randomized control arm is gem/doc itself. If the echo blocks doxorubicin, taking the fallback through the trial gives up nothing the standalone prescription offers and keeps the seat that a first off-protocol gemcitabine dose closes for good. The concern row already says call Houston first, so my ask is small: promote that footnote into the rank itself, gem/doc via NCT06498648 where eligible, off-protocol only if screening fails.

target_intervention_label: Pazopanib (later-line anchor, PALETTE)
comment: Rank 1 we agree on, so I aimed at rank 5, and I will concede up front what critic will press: my doxorubicin-trabectedin carriage claim rests on the LMS-04 publications plus KSGO 2025 (pmid:39900346), not on any NCCN category or ESMO-MCBS score I could verify this run. The sharper problem is what pazopanib displaced: this slate carries no locoregional option at all, though ESMO-EURACAN-GENTURIS CPG 2021 (pmid:34303806) has long carried complete excision of resectable lung metastases as standard local treatment in selected patients, and her roughly 23-month disease-free interval is the exact selector behind the uterine registry's 55.4% five-year OS (pmid:37063124). Those series are retrospective, but guideline committees read the same selected cohorts and still carried the option; that collective calibration earns the last slot ahead of a 2L drug whose OS curve never moved (pmid:22595799).

target_intervention_label: Ivonescimab (PD-1 x VEGF bispecific), MSK single-arm phase 2
comment: Concession first: putting a measured ECOG above any drug is the most guideline-literate move on any slate this round, since every eligibility bound the rest of us cited assumes a score nobody has written down. On ivonescimab I stay at qualified only because advocate priced it honestly: no guideline in any region carries the drug or its class in sarcoma, the class record in her disease is GOG-0250 (pmid:25713428) plus a futility stop at 0 of 12 (pmid:28440953), and the rank leans on a prefers_trials value the notes themselves admit was defaulted at intake. If her answers come back trial-and-travel, the route that honors them without leaving consensus is the abemaciclib seat with the carried gem/doc backbone as its control arm (nct:NCT06498648); the phone call is defensible, moving her to Manhattan on this record is not.

target_intervention_label: In vivo lung perfusion with doxorubicin plus metastasectomy (NCT02811523), as post-induction consolidation
comment: Right shelf, wrong door. Risktaker is the only other slate that takes lung-directed consolidation seriously, and the shelf itself has consensus footing the rest of the board mostly skipped: ESMO-EURACAN-GENTURIS CPG 2021 (pmid:34303806) carries complete excision of resectable lung metastases as standard local treatment in selected patients. The perfusion vehicle, though, is a phase 1 with no society carriage anywhere and a cumulative-doxorubicin exclusion above 450 mg that six full LMS-04 cycles nearly spends, so if induction earns a consolidation window the carried routes are wedge metastasectomy or SBRT (pmid:37532104), and the Toronto protocol (nct:NCT02811523) is the exception a tumor board argues for, not the default plan.
